name: 03_investigating_gdpr
description: Flagship scenario: a storage bucket goes public, then a large upload lands in it, then a suspicious API call fires from the same environment. Three signals correlate into one incident that exercises the full pipeline and is likely to trip the Root Cause Agent's gdpr_flag.
expected_outcome: correlates to correlated_count=3, severity escalates to critical, score = 40 (critical) + 40 (3 types) + 20 (azure_monitor) + 10 (public-read bucket anomaly) = 110 -> investigating (signal 1 alone = 80 queued, signal 2 = 95 investigating)
